catalogue_reconciliation.unit: PoC source file, not independent incident or attack execution

census_denominator_audit.interpretation: Conditional nonempty-day descriptor, not deployment-adjusted and not same-token rank readiness; no population estimate.

deployment_sensitivity.definition: Strictly predeployment UTC dates are removed using indexed creation transaction UTC time; the creation date itself is partial exposure and reported separately. Address creation metadata is not a proof of all historical code incarnations.

extension_study_reproduction.retained_output_comparison: Exact bytes for nine regenerated JSON/CSV outputs; read-only exact decomposition check.

limits: Raw integers are gross emitted core-boundary token outflows, not net loss or profit.
This decomposition uses stored event observations; it does not independently re-extract source logs.
The subsequent-extraction role is an explicit chain-sequence and actor-attribution inference.
The whitehat rescue remains in label-blind history but is not a harmful-extraction reference.
This is one fixed-core observed history, not a complete incident inventory or a general detection claim.

three_case_observation_audit.raw_feature_extraction_limitation: V6.1 stores feature aggregates and hashes, not raw indexed topics/data.

limits: Source identity and payload agreement is not receipt-root authentication.
Seven low-volume streams and the additional Nomad stream are exploratory selections.
Known reference inventories remain incomplete; no population recall or false-positive rate is established.
Full Phase30 raw indexed responses are retained; other phases retain the explicitly documented source tiers.

independent_audit.source_completeness_scope: Saved normalized selected bundles reconcile with frozen30-day census and source range receipts. Original Parquet bodies are not retained for offline byte-to-normalization reconstruction; no receipt-root authentication.

original_study_reproduction.limits: Recomputes retained inputs and verifies source receipts; does not repeat remote acquisition or authenticate receipt roots.

phase16.limits: Validates retained bytes and recomputes the exact reference join from sealed decisions. Historical source/role audits remain assertions supported by their retained evidence; this does not independently repeat raw-chain acquisition or prove those historical assertions.

phase30_raw_observations.source_tier: AWS-selected identities/counts plus retained Blockscout response bytes, full logs and success metadata

limits: Original AWS topics/data were not reconstructed by this offline audit.
Published normalized observations and archived manifests were checked; digest checks do not independently establish historical truth.
441 cells are repeated settings over seven nonrandom streams, not independent incident trials.
Uniform reference table is a provisional hash join; pending semantic roles remain pending.
